d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Watch the video song of "Lav Kush Ke Ghat Gyan Amrit Se Bharte Jate Hain" now!
Lav kush ko maharishi valmiki sabhi prakar ka gyan dete hain, jisse unke andar alag shaktiyan aur gyan ki vridhi maharishi valmiki ke sparsh matr se ho jati hai.
"svar- ravindr jain, hemalta aur dilraj kaur
Git- ravindr jain
Sangit- ravindr jain"
